problem_text:
A logistics company needs to distribute its total shipping volume across 18 different transportation routes to maximize total expected delivery efficiency.  
The characteristics of each route are as follows:  
* Route A: expected efficiency is 0.086, delay factor is 0.126, allocation bounds [0.049, 0.872]  
* Route B: expected efficiency is 0.172, delay factor is 0.031, allocation bounds [0.070, 0.710]  
* Route C: expected efficiency is 0.191, delay factor is 0.123, allocation bounds [0.048, 0.462]  
* Route D: expected efficiency is 0.087, delay factor is 0.144, allocation bounds [0.028, 0.681]  
* Route E: expected efficiency is 0.143, delay factor is 0.037, allocation bounds [0.004, 0.350]  
* Route F: expected efficiency is 0.111, delay factor is 0.145, allocation bounds [0.016, 0.342]  
* Route G: expected efficiency is 0.067, delay factor is 0.196, allocation bounds [0.047, 0.543]  
* Route H: expected efficiency is 0.178, delay factor is 0.271, allocation bounds [0.064, 0.479]  
* Route I: expected efficiency is 0.143, delay factor is 0.145, allocation bounds [0.032, 0.727]  
* Route J: expected efficiency is 0.132, delay factor is 0.035, allocation bounds [0.003, 0.823]  
* Route K: expected efficiency is 0.136, delay factor is 0.222, allocation bounds [0.060, 0.615]  
* Route L: expected efficiency is 0.153, delay factor is 0.276, allocation bounds [0.038, 0.702]  
* Route M: expected efficiency is 0.064, delay factor is 0.278, allocation bounds [0.094, 0.456]  
* Route N: expected efficiency is 0.168, delay factor is 0.233, allocation bounds [0.036, 0.798]  
* Route O: expected efficiency is 0.021, delay factor is 0.068, allocation bounds [0.043, 0.355]  
* Route P: expected efficiency is 0.174, delay factor is 0.105, allocation bounds [0.047, 0.841]  
* Route Q: expected efficiency is 0.072, delay factor is 0.102, allocation bounds [0.005, 0.505]  
* Route R: expected efficiency is 0.048, delay factor is 0.299, allocation bounds [0.087, 0.752]  

Each route must be assigned a fraction of the total shipping volume that lies within its specified allocation bounds, and the sum of all fractions must equal one.  
To ensure operational reliability, the company requires that the group of high-priority routes, represented by the subset L = {A, B, C, E, F, G, H, O, P, Q, R}, collectively receive at least 0.595 of the total shipping volume.  
At the same time, the overall delay index of the distribution plan must not exceed 0.260, and the total expected efficiency must be no less than 0.107.  
Please determine the optimal shipping volume allocation that maximizes total expected efficiency while satisfying all constraints.
